content:
Irene: Quick review from QA on compact controls in the dashboard: small screens show focus rings being clipped on compact buttons, the save-success toast is appearing underneath the sticky table column headers, and a recent spacing token tweak made compact rows feel visually collapsed. Can we go through fixes?

Ben: I repro the clipping. The row has `overflow: hidden` to handle rounded corners which trims the browser `outline`. Two options: a) give the button an outline-offset for compact variant, or b) render a focus shadow via `box-shadow` so it doesn't depend on outline.

Harper: Prefer keeping native outline for keyboard users, but outline-offset + negative margins on the row can be messy. Suggest `:focus-visible` with a high-contrast `box-shadow` fallback when outline is clipped. Also ensure `:focus` still works for assistive tech that doesn't set `:focus-visible`.

Zoe: Also spotted toast stacking issues. Toasts are rendered inside the same container as the table so `position: sticky` header wins in stacking context. Move toasts to a top-level overlay root appended to `document.body` and use `position: fixed` + `top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 8px)` for mobile. That avoids overlap and respects notches.

Irene: Good. Also please do not change global spacing tokens as a quick fix; that caused the compact row collapse. If we need smaller gaps for button spinner, add a component-scoped token like `--btn-inline-gap` instead of mutating `--space-1`.

Ben: CSS experiment I tried:
```
.btn--compact { min-width: 80px; height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--btn-inline-gap, 8px); }
.btn--compact:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(2,132,199,0.18); outline: none; }
.btn__spinner { width: 10px; height: 10px; margin-left: -2px; }
```
This keeps the label and adds a small inline spinner so width doesn't jump.

Harper: Accessibility: keep the text visible when loading and add `aria-live="polite" role="status"` on the toast. For the button, set `aria-label="Saving"` while loading rather than removing label text. Screen readers expect some text, not just a spinner.

Zoe: When moving overlay root to `body`, make sure to manage focus trap for modals so toasts don't steal focus. Toasts shouldn't be focus-trapping elements; they can be dismissable but should not interfere with modal keyboard flow.

ux-ci-bot: Test failure reminder: visual snapshot mismatch for compact-table-row on firefox-small. Please run the snapshot after changes.

Irene: Action plan: 1) Ben - inline spinner + new `--btn-inline-gap` token + min-width; 2) Zoe - toast portal to body + fixed positioning and mobile safe-area; 3) Harper - a11y doc blurb for loading buttons and toast live regions + add keyboard test cases. Target: ship patch by Thursday.

Ben: I'll open a small PR with CSS and a component token. Will include before/after screenshots and a regression snapshot.

Zoe: I'll change overlay mounting and add tests for stacking with sticky headers.

Harper: Drafting a11y guidance and will include sample DOM snippet and `aria` patterns. Will call out `prefers-reduced-motion` for spinner animation and `:focus-visible` rules.

Irene: One more note: consider telemetry for layout shift on table rows (small CLS metric) when the save action runs. If we can detect and emit a debug event it will help catch regressions after token tweaks.

ux-ci-bot: CI checklist: include visual snapshots, cross-browser coverage (Chrome/FF/Safari), and accessibility smoke tests.

Irene: Thanks — will follow up in Friday design sync with PR links.
